# The ECU Clinic

> ABS pump and module repair and car electronics fault diagnosis in Kaki Bukit, Singapore. Also Honda front radar (Honda Sensing) repair, BMW CAS module repair, Mercedes 7G and 9G TCU repair, Mercedes steering lock (ELV) repair, brand-new OEM hybrid batteries and BMW temperature programming. Repairs come with a 6-month warranty. Many car workshops send their ABS and module repairs to us.

- Address: Premier @ Kaki Bukit, 8 Kaki Bukit Avenue 4, #06-43, Singapore 415875
- WhatsApp or call: +65 9893 1923 (ask for Ching). WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 7pm. Saturday, 9am to 3pm. Closed on Sundays and public holidays. WhatsApp enquiries are welcome 24/7, and after-hours appointments can be arranged.
- Pick-up and delivery available. Hybrid battery warranty: 1 year or 100,000 km.

- [Mercedes 7G & 9G TCU Repair](https://theecuclinicsg.com/services/mercedes-7g-9g-tcu-repair/): Mercedes 7G-Tronic (722.9) TCU and conductor plate repair, done locally in Kaki Bukit: fault codes read first, new filter, gasket and oil on the same job. 9G-Tronic TCU too.
- [Mercedes Steering Lock (ELV) Repair](https://theecuclinicsg.com/services/mercedes-steering-lock-elv-repair/): Key won’t turn or Mercedes won’t start? We test and repair the electronic steering lock (ELV/ESL), or fit an ELV emulator, in Kaki Bukit. Pick-up if your car can’t be driven.
- [Hybrid Battery Replacement](https://theecuclinicsg.com/services/hybrid-battery-replacement/): Brand-new OEM hybrid battery replacement in Kaki Bukit, with a warranty of 1 year or 100,000 km. WhatsApp your car model and year: 9893 1923.

- [BMW Temperature Programming](https://theecuclinicsg.com/services/bmw-temperature-programming/): BMW coolant temperature programming in Kaki Bukit: bring a high running temperature down to about 95°C. Most models 2010–2018. WhatsApp 9893 1923.

## Fault codes we repair

- 121-11 (Honda): VSA Solenoid Valve Malfunction
- 81-19 / 81-20 (Honda): Yaw rate or acceleration sensor inside the VSA modulator
- U0416 (Honda): VSA system or VSA modulator control unit malfunction
- P2583 (Honda): Millimeter Wave Radar Function Error
- U3000-49 (Honda): Camera unit / millimeter wave radar internal failure
- 5001 (N30/4) (Mercedes-Benz): Internal fault in the ESP control unit
- A11E / A0AF / A0B4 (BMW): CAS: ELV fault, processor, engine start

Any other warning light or fault code: WhatsApp a photo of the scan tool or dashboard to +65 9893 1923.
